requirements.title: GET_COMMAND_ARGUMENT argument restrictions
requirements.definition: NUMBER shall be an integer scalar INTENT(IN), VALUE and ERRMSG shall be default character scalars, LENGTH and STATUS shall be integer scalars with decimal exponent range at least four, and the listed intents apply.

pending.GET_COMMAND_ARGUMENT-NUMBER-integer-scal: Positive source-control plan calls GET_COMMAND_ARGUMENT with integer scalar NUMBER values 0 and -1; mutation changes NUMBER to real and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.GET_COMMAND_ARGUMENT-VALUE-default-chara: Positive source-control plan uses a default character scalar VALUE prefilled with nonblank sentinels; mutation changes VALUE to a character array and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.GET_COMMAND_ARGUMENT-LENGTH-integer-scal: Positive source-control plan uses an integer scalar LENGTH sentinel such as -7777; mutation changes LENGTH to logical and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.GET_COMMAND_ARGUMENT-STATUS-integer-scal: Positive source-control plan uses an integer scalar STATUS sentinel such as -7777; mutation changes STATUS to real and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.GET_COMMAND_ARGUMENT-ERRMSG-default-char: Positive source-control plan uses a default character scalar ERRMSG sentinel; mutation changes ERRMSG to nondefault kind and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.GET_COMMAND_ARGUMENT-argument-intents: Source-control plan verifies conforming definable OUT and INOUT actuals and does not claim diagnostics for unnumbered argument restrictions.

requirements.title: GET_COMMAND_ARGUMENT VALUE and LENGTH distinguish existing and absent arguments

pending.GET_COMMAND_ARGUMENT-absent-length-zero: Call GET_COMMAND_ARGUMENT(-1, LENGTH=length) with LENGTH initialized to -7777 and assert LENGTH equals zero.
pending.GET_COMMAND_ARGUMENT-length-independent-: Call GET_COMMAND_ARGUMENT(-1) with VALUE absent and with a one-character VALUE buffer; assert LENGTH remains zero in both calls and mutate the check to LEN(VALUE).
pending.GET_COMMAND_ARGUMENT-existing-value-proc: No portable oracle may require exact spelling of an existing command argument supplied by the processor or command environment.

requirements.definition: STATUS is assigned a processor-dependent positive value for out-of-range NUMBER or command retrieval failure, -1 for too-short VALUE with an existing argument, and zero otherwise.

pending.GET_COMMAND_ARGUMENT-status-zero-for-non: Guarded plan calls GET_COMMAND_ARGUMENT(0, VALUE=value, LENGTH=len, STATUS=st) with VALUE long enough for the observed LENGTH after a successful length probe; branch STATUS==0 asserts only zero status, observed nonnegative LENGTH, and no exact command-name spelling.
pending.GET_COMMAND_ARGUMENT-status-positive-fai: No portable oracle may compare the positive command-retrieval failure status value to a processor-independent integer; guarded plans use positivity only and keep exact message and command-name spelling out of scope.
